company_description: Super Micro Computer, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, develops and sells server and storage solutions based on modular and open-standard architecture in the United States, Asia, Europe, and internationally. The company provides liquid and air-cooled AI servers for training and inferencing with integrated graphics processing units (GPUs) or PCIe based architectures; SuperBlade, MicroBlade, FlexTwin, GrandTwin, and BigTwin blade and multi-node systems; SuperStorage systems; Hyper, CloudDC, and WIO and rackmount systems; embedded (5G/IoT/Edge) systems; and MicroCloud server systems. It also offers workstations and networking devices; and modular server subsystems and accessories, including server boards, chassis, power supplies, and other accessories. In addition, the company provides remote system management solutions, such as Server Management suite comprising Supermicro Server Manager, Supermicro Power Management software, Supermicro Update Manager, SuperCloud Composer, and SuperDoctor 5. risks.title: Material weaknesses in financial controls
risks.summary: The company has not remediated its material weaknesses in financial controls, threatening the reliability of its financial statements and regulatory compliance.
risks.score_rationale: The risk is at the top of the 'Risks Related to Previous Delinquent SEC Reporting Obligations' section and describes unremediated material weaknesses in internal controls. The language is strong: 'not effective', 'prevent fraud and errors', 'investors may lose confidence'. Compared to the prior year, the situation persists as of June 30, 2025. The Regulation category carries a high weighting for material non-compliance. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Delays in SEC reporting obligations
risks.summary: Failure to meet financial report filing deadlines has already damaged the company's reputation and stock price.
risks.score_rationale: The delay in filing 10-K and 10-Q reports is explicitly mentioned as having caused downward pressure on the stock price, lost business opportunities, and increased costs. The language is alarming: 'delinquent', 'downward pressure on stock price', 'reputational harm'. This is a recurring risk from the prior year. The Regulation category is critical here. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Dependence on concentrated key customers
risks.summary: High sales concentration among a few customers exposes the company to sudden revenue declines.
risks.score_rationale: The risk is listed early in the operational section and mentions a 'substantial' risk of revenue loss if a major customer reduces orders. The language is clear: 'sales are concentrated', 'revenue may decrease substantially'. It is stable compared to prior year. The Competition category implies vulnerability in commercial negotiations. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Volatility of critical components
risks.summary: Price and availability fluctuations of critical components can impact margins and delivery capacity.
risks.score_rationale: The risk is mentioned as affecting cost, delivery, and warranty management. The language is concerning: 'adversely affected by volatility'. It is stable compared to prior year. The Industrial category is important in the context of a strained supply chain. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Dependence on Ablecom and Compuware
risks.summary: The company relies heavily on a few partners for production and storage, creating interruption risk.
risks.score_rationale: The text highlights a dependency risk on a limited number of providers for manufacturing and warehousing. The language is explicit: 'reliance on a limited source'. This is a stable structural risk. The Industrial category reflects a major operational vulnerability. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: AI and technological innovation risk
risks.summary: Recent AI-driven growth carries technological and operational risks if expectations are not met.
risks.score_rationale: The text links the company's recent success to the AI industry while highlighting its 'risks and uncertainties'. The language is cautious: 'driven a portion of our recent success', 'presents risks'. This is an emerging but central risk. The Technology category is highly strategic. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Ongoing litigation and legal investigations
risks.summary: The company faces lawsuits and investigations that could result in significant costs or sanctions.
risks.score_rationale: The risk is mentioned as potentially resulting in substantial costs and changes to business practices. The language is strong: 'substantial costs', 'material adverse effect'. It is stable compared to prior year. The Litigation category has a direct impact on results and reputation. (default score, to be refined)
